title: ExtractedRule
description: Strict JSON shape that the Azure AI Search GenAI prompt skill (or any equivalent LLM authoring caller) must emit for a single rule extracted from a policy chunk. The contract is enforced both at authoring time (output validation) and at indexer projection time (snapshot pull). All fields are required unless explicitly noted.

ruleId.description: Stable, human-readable rule id. SCREAMING-KEBAB or SCREAMING_SNAKE. Must be unique within a domain. Re-extracting the same chunk MUST yield the same id (deterministic from chunk + version).

naturalLanguage.description: Single-sentence statement of the rule, suitable for a reviewer.

predicate.description: Microsoft RulesEngine bool LambdaExpression — applicability gate. Default 'true' = always applies to selector matches. Use to scope a rule to a category or document kind.

lambda.description: Microsoft RulesEngine bool LambdaExpression — pass/fail determination. For semantic rules, MUST be of the form: SemanticFunctions.MatchesAnyMeaning(input1.id, "<concept1>|<concept2>|...", <threshold>). The threshold is a placeholder (0.55) at extraction time and is replaced with the calibrated value during Phase B (issue #73).

concepts.description: Paraphrase concepts that express the rule. Pipe-joined into the lambda. Each concept is independently embedded by integrated vectorization. Must cover ≥3 distinct phrasings, including at least one terse phrase and one CSP/architecture-vocabulary phrase.

severity.description: Maps to LambdaRag.Core.Domain.RuleSeverity. Mandatory ARB controls = Violation.

applicability.description: Mandatory rules surface silent gaps when no section matches. Optional rules don't.

remediation.description: Reviewer-facing guidance rendered when the rule fails. Must explain WHAT to add and WHY it matters. May reference the source policy.

evidenceQuote.description: Short canonical phrase that anchors the rule in the source text — used by the markup overlay and by reviewers as a sanity check.

examples.description: Self-validation corpus consumed by Phase B (#73). Three positives, three negatives — ranker scores must separate. Required at extraction time so the validation gate has something to score.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value metadata carried into Rule.Metadata. Recommended keys: sourcePolicy, category, mandatory, reviewer.

status.description: Rule approval status. Defaults to 'approved' — new rules land enabled.

rulesetName.description: Ruleset name (e.g., 'architecture-review'). Derived from blob metadata or env default.

rulesetVersion.description: Ruleset version (e.g., '2026.05'). Derived from blob metadata or env default.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hex over naturalLanguage + lambda + predicate (prefixed, delimited). Used for snapshot hash.

approvedAtUtc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of extraction/approval. Set to now() at extraction time.

approvedBy.description: Approval agent UPN or 'system'. Defaults to 'system' at extraction time.
